SELECT
    RAWTOHEX(t.TERMINAL_ID)      AS TERMINAL_ID,
    RAWTOHEX(t.POS_ID)           AS POS_ID,
    RAWTOHEX(t.POS_CONDITION_ID) AS POS_CONDITION_ID,
    p.POS,
    pc.POS_CONDITION,
    RAWTOHEX(t.MCC_ID)           AS MCC_ID,

    CASE
        /* MCC + Category + MDR */
        WHEN m.MCC IS NOT NULL
             AND TRIM(m.MCC) IS NOT NULL
             AND m.CATEGORY_EN IS NOT NULL
             AND TRIM(m.CATEGORY_EN) IS NOT NULL
             AND m.FINAL_MDR IS NOT NULL
        THEN
            m.MCC || ' | ' ||
            m.CATEGORY_EN || ' | (' ||
            TO_CHAR(
                m.FINAL_MDR * 100,
                'FM999990.00'
            ) || '%)'

        /* MCC + Category */
        WHEN m.MCC IS NOT NULL
             AND TRIM(m.MCC) IS NOT NULL
             AND m.CATEGORY_EN IS NOT NULL
             AND TRIM(m.CATEGORY_EN) IS NOT NULL
        THEN
            m.MCC || ' | ' ||
            m.CATEGORY_EN

        /* MCC + MDR */
        WHEN m.MCC IS NOT NULL
             AND TRIM(m.MCC) IS NOT NULL
             AND m.FINAL_MDR IS NOT NULL
        THEN
            m.MCC || ' | (' ||
            TO_CHAR(
                m.FINAL_MDR * 100,
                'FM999990.00'
            ) || '%)'

        /* MCC only */
        WHEN m.MCC IS NOT NULL
             AND TRIM(m.MCC) IS NOT NULL
        THEN
            m.MCC

        /* Category + MDR */
        WHEN m.CATEGORY_EN IS NOT NULL
             AND TRIM(m.CATEGORY_EN) IS NOT NULL
             AND m.FINAL_MDR IS NOT NULL
        THEN
            m.CATEGORY_EN || ' | (' ||
            TO_CHAR(
                m.FINAL_MDR * 100,
                'FM999990.00'
            ) || '%)'

        /* Category only */
        WHEN m.CATEGORY_EN IS NOT NULL
             AND TRIM(m.CATEGORY_EN) IS NOT NULL
        THEN
            m.CATEGORY_EN

        /* MDR only */
        WHEN m.FINAL_MDR IS NOT NULL
        THEN
            '(' ||
            TO_CHAR(
                m.FINAL_MDR * 100,
                'FM999990.00'
            ) || '%)'

        ELSE NULL
    END AS MCC

FROM TALY_BO_REP.MMS_TERMINAL t

LEFT JOIN TALY_BO_REP.MMS_POS p
    ON p.POS_ID = t.POS_ID

LEFT JOIN TALY_BO_REP.MMS_POS_CONDITION pc
    ON pc.CONDITION_ID = t.POS_CONDITION_ID

LEFT JOIN TALY_BO_REP.MMS_MCC_MDR m
    ON m.MCC_ID = t.MCC_ID

WHERE t.REQUEST_ID =
      HEXTORAW(
          REPLACE(
              '{{appsmith.URL.queryParams.requestId}}',
              '-',
              ''
          )
      )
  AND t.IS_DELETED = 0

ORDER BY t.CREATED_AT
